readabilityLimits: All four components are one front/top painted view, with fixed lighting; shared instances are not new authored frames.
Opaque pin caps permit overlap registration, but do not prove perfect contour/paint matching once rotated.
Upper/lower actual source axes are tilted; never use texture centre or assume vertical/collinear.
Lower is one fixed-medium-extension piece. Physics fixed-link projection is separate from authoring a telescoping cylinder.
Foot is one flat projected source; no lifted underside or alternate pitch surfaces were authored.
Fore links can overlap/cross body optics or folded calibration manipulators if the layout/z is wrong; only parent display inspection can accept that.
